integrity: The proof derives the second residual-minimizing polynomial from first principles, proves an exact pairwise spectral-barycenter identity, and supplies a sharp three-mode family for every condition number above two. The packaged exact-rational checker independently replays the critical algebra and witness.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the first two unpreconditioned MINRES iterates for symmetric positive definite Stieltjes systems. It does not classify later iterates in dimension at least three, preconditioned MINRES, indefinite systems, or non-Stieltjes SPD matrices.
title: Condition two is the sharp second-iterate positivity frontier for MINRES
